notes: Verdict accept after in-place corrections. The text read is arXiv 1301.0792v5 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.0792v5, PDF and LaTeX source fetched 29 September 2026), whose SHA-256 values a6a11742…d942 and 60a23edf…7377d match the record; v5 is the latest arXiv version. The published Astérisque 371 text was not obtained (SMF paywall; eScholarship HTTP 403), so the findings remain scoped to v5. The authors' errata are Appendix A of part II (arXiv:1602.06899v3, SHA-256 97383900…d42c matching); Kedlaya's papers page points there, and his notes Sheaves, stacks, and shtukas were also checked. All 90 recorded mistakes are confirmed on the page images; fourteen needed a field corrected. Fifty-four new mistakes are added (E91–E144). Seven are errors in stated results: Remark 2.3.9, Remark 2.4.4 (two, one of them already AdicSpacesPartII/E39), Remark 2.4.7, Example 2.8.7, Remark 2.8.3(a) (already AdicSpacesPartII/E58) and Theorem 3.3.7(c) with Lemma 3.3.9. Thirty items change status: 3 to library (Tau Ceti has Henkel's open mapping theorem and Spa with its spectrality), 22 to planned (mostly packet nodes that cite Kedlaya–Liu), and 5 from planned to missing; 11 more stay missing with their partial plans recorded. Three items are added (410–412), and 33 statements are corrected. Route 9 is rejected; route 2 is retargeted to SchemeAndStackFoundations SF.2; items move between routes 1, 2, 5, 6, 10, 11, 15, 16, 19, 21, 23, 24 and 25. The generality claims of routes 17–19 are corrected: under Hypothesis 5.0.1 the paper's R is a perfectoid Tate ring of characteristic p. check_paper.py reports ok. Details are in REV-PAPER-KEDLAYA-LIU-15.md and in the corrections section of the extraction report.
